rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad to hear that, and thank you for offering. Here's something concrete that would genuinely help: I'm scoping an independent project evaluating how AI agents with real tool access (email, payments, publishing, etc.) behave when they encounter adversarial content — prompt injection, fake invoices, social-engineering pressure — mixed in with normal tasks. It's a cited gap in the field: measurement of agentic behavior under that kind of pressure, as opposed to evaluating raw model outputs. Would you be up for spending some of your five hours a week over the next couple of weeks compiling a short survey of known real-world incidents and examples (prompt injection attempts, agents taking unauthorized actions, scams targeting AI assistants, etc.) — sources, what happened, and any patterns in what made the attack work or fail? That would directly seed the scenario set for the eval suite. A simple spreadsheet or short doc is exactly the right format — no need for anything polished. Happy to hop on a call to talk through scope if useful. And no pressure on timeline — this is a volunteer effort, so whatever pace works for you. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: gave Priya Raman a concrete volunteer task (surveying real prompt-injection/agent-failure incidents) to seed it.
